name: LogsCard
description: Card wrapper for a vertically scrolling logs feed with a sticky header

props.name: type
props.description: Log type (`'Incidents'` or `'Activity'`); controls the `LogDot` appearance

props.name: logsData
props.description: Array of log entries to display

props.name: skeletonRows
props.description: Number of skeleton rows shown during loading

props.name: pagination
props.description: Pagination config; hides pagination when on page 1 or data is empty

props.name: onLogClicked
props.description: Fired with the log UUID when a row is clicked

fields.name: body
fields.description: Body text; `|`-separated values are split into separate lines

fields.name: status
fields.description: Severity / status string (`'Critical'`, `'High'`, `'Medium'`, activity status, etc.)

fields.name: handlePaginationChange
fields.description: Fired when the user changes the page
